Unit: FILES
Eligibility definition: released revision effective for the asset and work date
Exclusion definition: draft, superseded, or wrong-asset procedures
Control: document number, revision, approval, and asset applicability must match

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000030, organization SEA, and CASE-030. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from PM work-order start window; external timing is conditional on safety office release confirmation. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

# lockout revision and applicability matrix

Case: CASE-030
Document control number: SPEC-0030
Effective revision: R3
Superseded revision visible in archive: R8
Subject: revised lockout procedure
Primary measure: candidate procedure revisions
Source finished or header quantity: 3
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 FILES
Unit: FILES
Eligibility definition: released revision effective for the asset and work date
Exclusion definition: draft, superseded, or wrong-asset procedures
Control: document number, revision, approval, and asset applicability must match

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000030, organization SEA, and CASE-030. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from PM work-order start window; external timing is conditional on safety office release confirmation. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
